chapter: Las Vegas, Sinatra and later years
title: Working constantly; travel is easy; jazz always open
summary: He works nearly year-round now, travels easily and says jazz is endlessly interesting because it is always open.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I really look forward to work. I thought when I started out a couple of years ago, that maybe I'd just I'd just work five months a year --
-- or something like that. But, my goodness, this year, I worked and I've only got August and December. That's how much I worked this year.
Yeah. I had a few weeks in -- I had a few weeks -- two weeks in February. And I went home Thanksgiving, thinking I'd have -- I'd take four months and open in Dec -- Disney World March 28th.
So I went to Vegas again, at a new room, for a month, San Francisco and I had two weeks and I went to New Orleans, and then -- and
I've been working ever since. And I don't get back -- I won't go home until August 7th.
I mean, don't you get physically tired, no?
No. No, Helen I travel very easy, I think. I travel -- it's no big problem for me to travel.
I guess I've done it all my life --
And I'm rather stoic about thing happens.
And if you enjoy working at a club, the time goes awfully fast.
It really does. Now, I will be here you know, four weeks, it's un -- it's -- do you realize I'm starting on my third week already?
No. And, of course -- you never talk about it, but there's the pleasure of the people that love you that
come and see you in each different place. You know you -- you -- you keep renewing acquaintances with people to whom you mean something, which is pleasurable.
Friends, I mean it's very nice.

-- yeah. And I enjoy it and it's fun to go to work. It's always been that way with me. I'm happy to say it. I've never been disappointed or morose about being in a position where I had to keep doing it. But I think jazz has that beautiful thing about it. That -- it's always open to be interesting.
There's so many things that can be done and different feelings and different nights, I try to recapture -- try to do something a different way. But you don't know how it's going to be the next time.
But -- you never know what the next thing is going to be like. So that's --
